# Nora TrimTex

Nora TrimTex is a multilingual catalogue and online ordering service for curtain trimmings: tassels, wall hooks, rosettes, fringes, decorative borders, braids and cords for interior projects.

## Languages
- Russian: /ru
- Ukrainian: /uk
- German: /de
- English: /en

## Main sections
- Product catalogue: /en/catalog
- Product pages: /en/product/{product-slug}
- About the brand: /en/about

## Contact
- Website: https://noratrim.com
- Email: info@noratrim.com

Products are identified by stable article numbers (SKU). Product pages show visual colour variants, availability status and a B2B order workflow. Wholesale prices are private and are only displayed to authenticated trade partners.
